passages.text: Exacum ({{IPAc-en|ˈ|ɛ|k|s|ə|k|əm}} {{respell|EK|sə|kəm}}) is a genus of plant in family Gentianaceae. It contains 75 species native to tropical regions of sub-Saharan Africa, southern Arabian Peninsula, south and southeast Asia, New Guinea, and Australia.
